Learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing the matter for some time, submits that the petition may be dismissed as not pressed with liberty to the petitioner to renew his application after the victim girl is examined before the Trial Court.
2. The submission is placed on record.
3. Criminal Petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
4. The Trial Court is directed to examine the victim girl on priority.
